skeleton.description: Skeleton drawn while loading, and the shape an empty slot shows while this element's server render is in flight (`none` opts out).

entity.description: RECORD-cardinality: renders ONE record (see body collapse below).

onTitleCommit.description: When bound, the title becomes editable in place: clicking it swaps the heading for an input, Enter or blur commits, Escape reverts. Receives the committed title and the record's id so the host can persist a partial update. Unbound, the title stays a plain heading.

actions.description: Unified actions array - first action with variant='primary' is the main action

maxInlineActions.description: Max inline action buttons before the rest collapse into a "⋯" overflow menu (mirrors DataGrid's maxInlineActions). Defaults to 2 — primary + secondary visible, the rest under the menu — so every detail panel carries the same action pattern.

backAction.description: Navigation-back affordance. Renders top-LEFT before the title (OS/back convention — Almadar_UX §8.4), spatially separated from the right-aligned action buttons + close X. Never inferred from actions[] labels.

closeEvent.description: The event of the declared action that dismisses the panel. The matching action renders as the header close ×; omitted, no × is drawn.

surface.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out. Inline mode only; the slide-over is itself a surface.

fields.description: Fields to display: field names, or declared fields ({ name, label, variant, format, colorMap, labels })

initialData.description: Initial data for edit mode (passed by compiler)

showActions.description: When false, hides the action buttons + overflow menu (and the close ×). Defaults to true.

relationsData.description: Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names.

look.description: Page variant: panel (labelled fields, default), profile (person/member hero), showcase (image-first product/listing), workflow (lifecycle stepper + activity), map (location hero), ledger (document with line items + totals), conversation (thread beside the record), workspace (tabbed record).

avatarField.description: Record field holding the avatar image. The profile look always shows an avatar, with the title's initials when this is unset or empty.

coverField.description: Record field holding the cover image (profile).

mediaField.description: Record field holding the image, or list of images, the showcase look leads with.

stageField.description: Record field holding the current lifecycle stage (workflow).

stages.description: The lifecycle in order, `{ value, label }` per stage (workflow).

activity.description: Activity entries shown under the record (workflow).

activityContent.description: Activity composed in instead of `activity` — e.g. the record's own history trait (workflow).

lineItems.description: Child rows shown as the document's line items (ledger).

lineItemsContent.description: Line items composed in instead of `lineItems` — e.g. the child rows' own trait (ledger).

totals.description: Record fields shown as the document's totals, in order (ledger).

thread.description: The thread shown as the main surface (conversation).

threadContent.description: The thread composed in instead of `thread` — e.g. the replies' own trait with its composer (conversation).

tabs.description: Tabs after the overview tab, each listing declared field names (workspace).

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.

navItems.description: Navigation items. Apps that need a Settings page should add it as a navItems entry, not depend on baked-in chrome.

user.description: Current user info (optional - auto-populated from auth context if not provided). Accepts `null` as well as `undefined`: the `.lolo` substrate's signed-out spelling is `(if @config.viewerName {…} null)`, and the compiled path passes that `null` through verbatim.

showSearch.description: Show the top-bar search box. Default `false` — opt in by setting `searchEvent` (any truthy value implies showSearch) or this flag.

searchEvent.description: Declarative search event — fires `UI:{searchEvent}` on the bus when the user submits the search box (Enter key). Setting this implies `showSearch=true`. Use `onSearchSubmit` for direct React usage instead.

onSearchSubmit.description: React-side search submit callback. Used when the host wires the layout directly (not via render-ui pattern resolution).

topBarActions.description: Generic top-bar action buttons rendered between the search bar and the notifications bell. Each entry: `{icon, label?, event, badge?, variant?}`. Domain-agnostic — consumers add a cart icon, profile button, help-bubble, or any other top-bar action by appending entries. Empty array (default) renders nothing.

userMenuItems.description: Account-menu entries listed above Sign out (Settings, a profile page), each `{icon, label, event?, navigatesTo?, variant?}` like `topBarActions`.

fullBleed.description: Content fills the area edge to edge — no padding, no max width, full height (workspaces, canvases, maps).

notifications.description: Notification list. Pass an empty array to show the bell with no badge; omit / pass null to hide the bell entirely.

notificationClickEvent.description: Declarative bell click event — fires `UI:{notificationClickEvent}` on the bus with an empty payload when the user clicks the bell.

showThemeToggle.description: Show the theme toggle button in the header. Default `true` — universally useful for a11y / dark mode.

sidebarFooter.description: Custom sidebar footer (optional). When omitted, the sidebar has no footer — apps that need Settings/etc. add them via navItems.

sidebarContent.description: Optional content region rendered between the nav links and the footer — a page tree or any consumer navigation surface; scrolls independently and takes the sidebar's remaining height. Hidden in the collapsed rail.

currentPath.description: Active path used to highlight the matching nav item. Falls back to `useCurrentPagePath()` (set by `CurrentPagePathProvider`), then to `useLocation().pathname`. Production deploys can omit it; the studio preview passes the in-frame `?page=` value so highlighting works inside the embedded playground where `pathname` would be the studio route.

onSignOut.description: The trait's reaction to Sign out; the host ends the session through `UI:SIGN_OUT` either way.

layoutMode.description: Layout mode. Default `"sidebar"`. - `sidebar`: Left sidebar nav + top header (classic dashboard) - `topnav`: Horizontal nav in header, no sidebar - `bottomnav`: Bottom tab bar, no sidebar - `minimal`: No nav chrome, content only - `drawer`: Sidebar nav behind a menu button at every width; content gets the full width

children.description: Page content rendered inside the main area

nodeSpacing.description: Minimum empty gap (px) enforced between node edges so nodes never overlap.

linkOpacity.description: Base opacity for links when nothing is hovered (kept faint so dense graphs stay readable; incident links brighten on hover).

code-block.description: CodeBlock Molecule Component  A syntax-highlighted code block with copy-to-clipboard functionality. Preserves scroll position during re-renders.  Event Contract: - Emits: UI:COPY_CODE { language, success }

language.description: Programming language for syntax highlighting (any Prism id; loaded on demand if not pre-registered)

foldable.description: Enable brace-based code folding of multi-line `{}`/`[]` blocks (default: true).

editable.description: When true, render an editable surface that composes a transparent `Textarea` over a Prism-highlighted overlay. The overlay re-tokenizes on each keystroke (driven from a local mirror of the textarea value), so users see syntax-highlighted code while still being able to type. Folding is skipped in editable mode. History: GAP-51 first-cut shipped plain (no-highlighting) editable text; GAP-77 (2026-04-12) added the Prism overlay layer. Default: false (existing read-only behavior unchanged).

onChange.description: GAP-51: called with the new code on every keystroke when `editable === true`. Consumers should debounce + parse downstream — `CodeBlock` does not.

errorLines.description: GAP-80: line-level error/warning highlights. Map of 1-based line number → severity. Paints a colored background on each line: error = red, warning = yellow. Honored by the editable overlay and (GAP-84) by viewer mode's non-diff highlight; pass undefined (default) to disable. The consumer is responsible for computing the path → line map from the schema + validation results.

highlightLines.description: Lines to mark and keep in view (1-based, inclusive): the code of the step a running program just took.

oldValue.description: Old source text — generates diff when combined with newValue

newValue.description: New source text — generates diff when combined with oldValue

showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in code / diff mode

wordWrap.description: Enable word-wrap in code / diff mode

naturalLanguages.description: Show the program in these natural languages as tabs, translating on the fly. Only meaningful for `language` 'lolo' / 'orb'; ignored otherwise. Fewer than two entries renders exactly as without the prop. `editable` wins: editing a translation is not a thing, so the English source is shown and this is ignored.

showCopy.description: Show copy button (viewer alias for showCopyButton)

editorId.description: Stable identity for the keyboard router / plugin host to target this editor. Unset = this instance never receives capability events.

onEditorFocus.description: Declarative bus emit fired when this editor gains focus.

onEditorBlur.description: Declarative bus emit fired when this editor loses focus.

onMotion.description: Declarative bus listen: move the cursor per the vim-style motion vocabulary.

onOperate.description: Declarative bus listen: apply a text operator over a motion's range.

onInsertText.description: Declarative bus listen: insert literal text at the cursor.

onSetMode.description: Declarative bus listen: switch editor mode and caret style.

onKey.description: Emits UI:{onKey} with the keystroke for each key the latest SET_MODE for this editor listed, and keeps it out of the text. No capture without it.

motions.description: Motion vocabulary this editor accepts. Default: the full `EditorMotion` set.

operators.description: Operator vocabulary this editor accepts. Default: the full `EditorOperator` set.

completions.description: Editable only: answers the caret's valid continuations after a keystroke (and on Ctrl-Space); they show under the editor and Tab or a click inserts one.

assist.description: Editable only: model-assisted editing. Asked after a pause (and on Ctrl-Space) for a completion at the caret, shown as ghost text; on ⌘/Ctrl-. for fixes, listed under the editor. Tab accepts the next, ⌘/Ctrl-Enter accepts all, Escape dismisses.

problems.description: Editable only: how many problems the host knows the code has (some, like a parse error, have no line to mark). With `assist`, the editor offers to fix them.

diagnostics.description: Editable only: problems located in the code (1-based line/column in characters, `endColumn` just past the last one), each underlined exactly — red wavy for an error, amber for a warning, dotted where the position is approximate. The message of the one under the caret shows below the editor.

definitionAt.description: Editable only: go to definition. Whether the identifier (a dotted path is one) leads somewhere; with Cmd/Ctrl held the one under the pointer is underlined when it does. Comments and strings never qualify.

onGoToDefinition.description: Editable only: Cmd/Ctrl+click, or Cmd/Ctrl+Enter at the caret, on an identifier `definitionAt` accepts.

diagnosticsCode.description: The code `diagnostics` were computed on. When the editor's text has moved on, each range is carried over the edit; a range the edit touches is dropped until the code is checked again. Absent: they describe the current text.

lineNumbers.description: Editable only: number the lines in a gutter (lines with errors in red). Default on.

dayWindow.description: Override the viewport-driven day window. `'auto'` (default) tracks `window.innerWidth` — 1 day on mobile, 3 on tablet, 7 on laptop+. Pass an explicit number to force a fixed window (useful for print layouts or screenshot tests).

titleField.description: Row field holding the chip label. Defaults to `title`. Lets a host bound to its own entity name the column instead of being forced to rename its fields to this grid's contract (same accessor idiom as `DataList`'s `senderField` / `DataGrid`'s `imageField`).

startField.description: Row field holding the start timestamp (ISO or epoch). Defaults to `startTime`.

endField.description: Row field holding the end timestamp (ISO or epoch). Defaults to `endTime`. When a row carries an end, the event's chip renders in its start slot and every further slot it covers shows a subdued continuation bar — without this, multi-hour events silently collapsed to their first hour.

colorField.description: Row field holding the chip's Tailwind colour class. Defaults to `color`.

children.description: Render function for one event chip's content. Receives the row and its index in the materialised events array. The grid keeps ownership of placement, colour and the click target; this replaces only what is drawn INSIDE the chip, so a host can show a time + instructor + badge stack instead of the default single label.

renderItem.description: Per-event render function (schema-level alias for the children render prop). In `.orb`: `["fn", "item", { pattern tree with @item.field bindings }]`. In `.lolo`: `renderItem: (fn item <Component …={@item.field}/>)` — the same contract `data-list` / `data-grid` / `carousel` already use.

data-grid.description: DataGrid — structured records grid rendering rows over configurable columns, with sort, select, and drag-reorder.
data-grid.capabilities: admin table, records grid, user list, CRUD list, manage-records view, spreadsheet-style data grid, sortable columns

dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

reorderEvent.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }

positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

emptyIcon.description: Domain icon for the empty state.

emptyDescription.description: What will appear here once rows exist.

entity.description: Schema entity data — the collection of rows to render. pattern-sync tags it `kind:"entity", cardinality:"collection"` so consumers bind the domain entity without name-matching the prop.

fields.description: Field definitions for rendering each card. The pattern contract in `@almadar/core/patterns` documents `columns` as the wire-format alias the compiler emits — both names resolve to the same shape here. Pass either.

columns.description: Alias for `fields` — the compiler emits `columns` for field defs.

itemClickEvent.description: When set, clicking a card emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row }. Omit = cards are not clickable.

maxInlineActions.description: Max inline primary action buttons before the rest collapse into a "⋯" overflow menu. Omit = all inline.

scrollX.description: Lay items in a single horizontally-scrolling row (kanban columns) sized to `minCardWidth` instead of a wrapping grid.

cols.description: Number of columns (uses auto-fit if omitted)

minCardWidth.description: Minimum card width in pixels (used when cols is not set, default 280)

skeleton.description: Skeleton drawn while loading, and the shape an empty slot shows while this element's server render is in flight (`none` opts out).

imageField.description: Entity field name containing an image URL for card thumbnails

selectionEvent.description: Selection change event name (emits UI:{selectionEvent} with { selectedIds: string[] })

loadMoreEvent.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

hasMore.description: Whether more items are available for infinite scroll

children.description: Render prop for custom per-card content. When provided, `fields` are ignored; `itemActions` render as a footer beneath the custom content.

renderItem.description: Per-item render function (schema-level alias for children render prop). In .orb schemas: ["fn", "item", { pattern tree with @item.field bindings }] The compiler converts this to the children render prop. In .lolo, author the per-item renderer as renderItem: (fn item <Component …={@item.field}/>), binding per-item fields via @item.field.

itemEnter.description: Entrance animation each card plays when it mounts; a card that changes place glides there. Lists rendered inside the grid share its movement, so a card moved between them glides across

pageSize.description: Max items to show before "Show More" button. Defaults to 0 (disabled).

look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the `entity-table` look enum so data-grid / data-list / entity-table share one knob name from authors.

surface.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out.

relationsData.description: Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names for a field whose type is relation. Same contract DetailPanel takes.

dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

reorderEvent.description: Event emitted on reorder: UI:{reorderEvent} with { fromIndex, toIndex }

positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

emptyIcon.description: Domain icon for the empty state.

emptyDescription.description: What will appear here once rows exist.

entity.description: Schema entity data — the collection of rows to render.

fields.description: Field definitions for rendering each row. The pattern contract in `@almadar/core/patterns` documents `columns` as the wire-format alias the compiler emits — both names resolve to the same shape here. Pass either.

columns.description: Alias for `fields` — the compiler emits `columns` for field defs.

itemEnter.description: Entrance animation each row plays when it mounts, so an item arriving in this list (moved from another) animates in

maxInlineActions.description: Max inline action buttons before the rest collapse into a "⋯" overflow menu. Omit = all inline.

itemClickEvent.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win).

groupBy.description: Group items by a field value (renders section headers between groups)

groupFormat.description: How a `groupBy` value is bucketed and labelled (`date` = one section per day)

senderField.description: Field name identifying the sender (used with variant: "message")

senderLabelField.description: Field holding the sender's human-readable name (used with variant: "message"). Defaults to `senderField`. Set this when `senderField` holds an id — an id-keyed thread otherwise labels bubbles `staff-1` instead of `Sam Staff`.

currentUser.description: Current user identifier; messages matching this value align right (used with variant: "message")

emptyMessage.description: Message shown when there are no rows. Falls back to the generic "no items" translation. `TableView` already exposes this; an agenda or an inbox wants to say what "empty" means in its own words.

skeleton.description: Skeleton drawn while loading, and the shape an empty slot shows while this element's server render is in flight (`none` opts out).

swipeLeftEvent.description: Event emitted on left swipe: UI:{swipeLeftEvent} with { row }

swipeRightEvent.description: Event emitted on right swipe: UI:{swipeRightEvent} with { row }

longPressEvent.description: Event emitted on long press: UI:{longPressEvent} with { row }

loadMoreEvent.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

hasMore.description: Whether more items are available for infinite scroll

children.description: Render prop for custom per-item content. When provided, `fields` and `itemActions` are ignored.

renderItem.description: Per-item render function (schema-level alias for children render prop). In .orb schemas: ["fn", "item", { pattern tree with @item.field bindings }] The compiler converts this to the children render prop. In .lolo, author the per-item renderer as renderItem: (fn item <Component …={@item.field}/>), binding per-item fields via @item.field.

pageSize.description: Max items to show before "Show More" button. Defaults to 5. Set to 0 to disable.

sortBy.description: Field name to order rows by. Values are compared by their own type — numbers numerically, date-like strings chronologically, everything else alphabetically — never by what the field is called. Empty cells sort last. Unset leaves the incoming order untouched. Orders only the rows already fetched: a collection larger than its `limit` still needs ordering at the data layer.

look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the `entity-table` look enum so data-grid / data-list / entity-table share one knob name from authors.

surface.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out.

relationsData.description: Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names for a field whose type is relation. Same contract DetailPanel takes.

trait-frame.description: TraitFrame — renders the current frame of a referenced trait.  Resolves the `@trait.X[.slot]` binding at render time by looking up the referenced trait's last `render-ui` payload from the orbital's `UISlotManager`. Re-renders automatically when that trait transitions via the per-trait subscription channel (`subscribeTrait`).  This is the single rendering primitive both runtime paths converge on:  - **Interpreted path** — the trait-binding resolver in `renderer/trait-binding-resolver.ts` walks pattern trees at render time, substituting `"@trait.X"` string children with this component. - **Compiled path** — the TypeScript shell codegen in `orbital-shell-typescript/src/backend.rs::pattern_to_jsx_with_data` emits this component directly into generated JSX wherever a `@trait.*` string appears in a pattern tree.  Embedding is passive: the referenced trait's state machine runs unchanged; TraitFrame is only a read-only lens on its current frame. Event propagation happens over the shared event bus, not through this component.

traitName.description: Name of the trait whose current frame to embed. Must match a trait declared in the current orbital. Compiler validates that the name exists at build time (see `ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_UNKNOWN`).

fallback.description: Rendered when the referenced trait has not (yet) emitted any render-ui. Use a skeleton, spinner, or message. Defaults to `null` (renders nothing), so an unfulfilled reference drops cleanly out of a parent `children:` array.

tree.description: The tree data (pre-nested). Ignored when `items` is provided.

items.description: Flat node list, nested by `parentId` at render time — takes precedence over `tree` when provided. A `parentId` with no matching row renders that node as a root rather than dropping it.

selectedId.description: Currently selected node id, in flat `items` mode: the row highlights and every ancestor auto-expands so the selection is always visible — the "you are here" a navigation tree needs.

look.description: Visual treatment for flat `items` mode: `files` (default) keeps the monospace file-browser look; `nav` renders a sidebar navigation tree — regular font, document icons, roomier hit areas.

onFileSelect.description: Called when a file is clicked

onNodeExpand.description: Called the first time a node marked `expandable` is expanded, with its path, so its children can be loaded.

expandedPaths.description: Paths to show expanded (e.g. to reveal a node): each is expanded when it appears here, loading its children if needed.

onNodeSelect.description: Called when a node is clicked, in flat `items` mode; carries the selected node's id. Presence-gated: binding this prop is what turns on the click-to-select affordance, mirroring Badge's `onRemove`.

onNodeAction.description: Called from the row's hover action button, in flat `items` mode; carries that node's id. Presence-gated: binding it renders the action.

nodeActionIcon.description: Icon for the row hover action (default: plus).

nodeActionLabel.description: Accessible label/tooltip for the row hover action.

onNodeReorder.description: Called when a row is dropped onto another, in flat `items` mode; carries the moved node's id, its new parent id (`null` for a root drop), and its index within the new parent's children. Presence-gated: binding this prop is what turns on row dragging.

table-view.description: TableView — sortable, selectable data table rendering rows over configurable columns, with inline row actions and grouping.

dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

reorderEvent.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }

positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

emptyIcon.description: Domain icon for the empty state.

emptyDescription.description: What will appear here once rows exist.

entity.description: Schema entity data — the collection of rows to render.

columns.description: Column definitions. The compiler emits `columns`; `fields` is the alias.

surface.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out.

itemActions.description: Per-row actions, collected under a trailing kebab overflow menu.

itemClickEvent.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win). Mirrors DataList's contract. Omit = rows are not clickable.

selectable.description: Render a leading checkbox column. Selection changes emit `selectEvent`.

selectEvent.description: Event emitted on selection change: UI:{selectEvent} with { selectedIds }.

selectedIds.description: Currently-selected ids (controlled). Falls back to local state when omitted.

sortEvent.description: Event emitted on sortable-header click: UI:{sortEvent} with { column, direction }.

sortColumn.description: Current sort column (display hint for the active header arrow).

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the table root.

emptyMessage.description: Message shown when there are no rows.

skeleton.description: Skeleton drawn while loading, and the shape an empty slot shows while this element's server render is in flight (`none` opts out).

groupBy.description: Group rows under section headers by a field value.

pageSize.description: Max rows before a "Show More" button. Defaults to 0 (show all).

children.description: Custom per-row render. When provided, the whole row content is delegated to this function (columns are ignored for the body; the header still renders). Mirrors DataList's children render prop.

renderItem.description: Per-row render function (schema alias). In .orb: ["fn","item",{...}]. The compiler converts this to the children render prop. In .lolo, author the per-row renderer as renderItem: (fn item <Component …={@item.field}/>), binding per-item fields via @item.field.

look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the data-list / entity-table look enum so authors share one knob name across row renderers.

relationsData.description: Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names for a column whose field is relation-typed. Same contract DetailPanel takes.

focusedOrbital.description: Current canvas focus orbital — only used by overlay mode. Tab mode ignores this.

disclosureLevel.description: Drives density: 1-2 → compact, 3-4 → full activity embed (when mode='overlay').

open.description: Whether the panel is visible. Typically auto-opens during generation in overlay mode.

coordinatorActivities.description: Full coordinator activities (tool calls, results, messages, errors).

coordinatorMessages.description: Canonical Coordinator conversation — same shape live and on reload. When present, takes precedence over `coordinatorActivities` for the Coordinator section.

mode.description: Rendering mode. - `'overlay'` (default): floating side panel positioned absolutely over the canvas. Density follows `disclosureLevel` (compact L1/L2, rich L3+). The `open` flag actually hides the panel when false. - `'tab'`: full-width content for a dedicated 'trace' supplemental tab. Always renders rich (regardless of disclosure level), always visible (the `open` flag is ignored), and includes an empty state when no subagents are present so users see the surface even before generation starts.

tileLeaveEvent.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.

keyMap.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` — optionally prefixed `Mod+` (⌘/Ctrl), `Shift+`, `Alt+` in that order — to the board's SEMANTIC event (device-agnostic input), emitted as `UI:{event}`; keystrokes inside inputs/textareas never route.

editable.description: --- Scene-edit mode (a game studio selecting/dragging drawables). Purely

onSelect.description: Fired on a click that changes selection — before `selectEvent`.

onMove.description: Fired once per drag gesture, on drop — before `moveEvent`.

moveEvent.description: Declarative move event, `UI:{moveEvent} { id, x, y }` — fired once on drop.

scale.description: Render scale, legacy-squared semantics: on-screen cell ≈ `256 × scale²` px (the authored contract every board tuned its value for). Converted internally to the single camera zoom against the board's native tile width, so the cell pitch follows the asset while the on-screen size stays as authored. Ignored when `fit` is on; passed through raw for `free`/`side` (world-pixel-direct).

tileWidth.description: Native tile/cell width in source px for this board's asset (e.g. 16 for Kenney tiny-dungeon, ~128 for iso blocks). The grid cell pitch follows the asset, so tile textures map 1:1 (crisp, no stretch). Defaults to the detected atlas tile width, else 256.

fit.description: Auto-fit the board's grid extent to the viewport (default false — boards render at their authored `scale` and overflow → pan). Opt in for whole-board-overview boards. User wheel/pinch zoom always wins after the initial fit.

followTarget.description: Follow-camera target in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.target`). When `camera:'follow'` the host lerps to keep this point centered.

cameraPos.description: Initial camera position in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.pos`). The host projects this to screen space and centers the viewport on it for the first render; ignored once the user pans or a follow target takes over.

bgColor.description: Solid backdrop colour — the base layer under any `backgroundImage`.

children.description: Declarative JSX drawable children (`<DrawShape .../>` composed in paint order). When `drawables` is empty, each child registers its descriptor via the drawable registry context and the host paints them.

fallback.description: Host-supplied stock content for a slot-host region (Studio V4 §14 Part I2). Ignored whenever `children` is passed — `children` (compiled mode) always wins, so a compiled organism's slot can never be silently shadowed by a host `fallback`. In `portal` mode `fallback` never portals: it paints inline at this component's own position in the tree, while slot content (if present) still portals as usual — a plugin filling `modal` doesn't relocate the host's inline empty-state.

mode.description: `'replace'` (default): slot content when present, else `fallback`. `'append'`: `fallback` first, then slot content when present — both render together, so `fallback` is a fixture, not just a placeholder.

systemMap.description: With `initialLevel="system"`: what an orbital chip does (drill in, hover preview, open code, preview).

openTraitsEvent.description: Emits UI:{openTraitsEvent} with { orbital } when an orbital on the system map is opened (drilled into).

systemDependencies.description: With `initialLevel="system"`: the app's imports, for the Dependencies lens (absent: Events only).

traitView.description: Trait level: which lens (and trait filter) shows — pass with `onTraitViewChange` to keep it across remounts.

openBehaviorEvent.description: Dependencies lens: emits UI:{openBehaviorEvent} with { name } to open a selected behavior's source.

keyMap.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` — optionally prefixed `Mod+` (⌘/Ctrl), `Shift+`, `Alt+` in that order — to an event, emitted as `UI:{event}`; keystrokes inside inputs/textareas never route.

scene.description: With `initialLevel="trait-expanded"`: played steps lighting each trait card's state machine.

onFocusChange.description: Fired when the focused orbital, the scope, or the focused card's state changes.

initialOrbital.description: The orbital cards open on (local view) — or, with `initialLevel="trait-expanded"`, the orbital whose traits are shown.

initialLevel.description: `trait-expanded`: one card per trait of `initialOrbital` (cosmic). Default: orbital cards.

focusedOrbital.description: Focus this orbital (e.g. picked in a Layers panel); changing it moves the focus without remounting.

initialSelectedNode.description: Pre-select a node on mount (opens OrbInspector).

editable.description: Enable editing in the inspector. When true, fields become inputs.

onSchemaChange.description: Called when the user edits the schema via the inspector.

onPatternDelete.description: Called when the user presses Delete/Backspace with patterns selected (all of a multi-select).

tools.description: Editing tools the canvas turns on (a persona's shell manifest declares them); all by default.

elementAccess.description: What each element lets the user change (knob, data-bound, fixed by a behavior); every prop is editable without it.

onEventWire.description: Called when the user drags from a source handle to a target handle (event wiring).

behaviorMeta.description: Behavior layer metadata for node styling (layer color bands).

orbitalStatus.description: Per-orbital generation status. Keyed by orbital name. Drives the spinner + accent border treatment on the overview node and (future) the hover trace surface. Defaults to `'idle'` for missing entries. Consumers derive this from agent subagent_start/complete SSE events.

onOrbitalHover.description: Hover handler for overview-level orbital nodes. Fires with the orbital name on enter and `null` on leave. Reserved for the upcoming trace tooltip: consumers will use it to anchor a popover that shows the subagent's live trace + reasoning for the hovered orbital.

layoutHint.description: Layout hint: 'pipeline' renders nodes left-to-right, 'grid' (default) uses sqrt-based grid.

onNodeSelect.description: Called when the user clicks a node in overview level (for composition hints).

userType.description: Studio persona viewing the canvas. Drives `OrbInspector` tab/section visibility — designers and builders hide the raw `code` tab and the architect-only Entity / raw-guard / raw-effects sections; architects see everything. Default `'builder'` preserves pre-Phase-2 behavior.

themeManifest.description: Project theme tokens (Design System tab only). Forwarded to `OrbInspector` so the Styles tab can render an editable token list when the selection originates from the synthesized `__design_system__` schema.

nodePositions.description: Persisted node positions keyed by node id. When the node set changes (level/schema switch), any id present here overrides the computed layout position, restoring a user's manual drag arrangement. Node ids are unique per view level, so a single flat map covers overview + expanded. A saved `width` restores a card frame the designer resized.

onPositionsChange.description: Fired on node drag-stop and card resize with the full {id → placement} map of the current node set, so the consumer can persist the arrangement.

onSelectedNodeChange.description: Fired whenever the internal `selectedNode` changes — select, clear-on- escape, clear-on-level-change, and pattern-selection sync all route through this. Lets a consumer mirror selection into a persistent properties panel rendered outside the canvas (see `externalInspector`).

onSelectedPatternChange.description: Fired whenever the in-node pattern selection changes (a pattern click inside `OrbPreviewNode`, cleared on background click / Escape / pattern delete). `PatternSelectionContext` is internal to this component's own render tree, so an externally-rendered `OrbInspector` (see `externalInspector`) has no other way to learn which pattern the user picked — pass this straight through to `OrbInspector`'s `selectedPattern` prop to keep Design-tab prop editing working outside the canvas.

externalInspector.description: When true, FlowCanvas does not render its inline `OrbInspector` — the consumer is expected to render one externally, fed by `onSelectedNodeChange` + `onSelectedPatternChange`. Selection highlighting, keyboard delete, and every other behavior is unchanged. Default `false` preserves the built-in inline panel.

verify.description: A host that verifies from the canvas: cards show verify controls and the trait's verdict, and follow `UI:CANVAS_SHOW_STATE` to the states a run reaches.

skeleton.description: Skeleton shown while this element's server render is in flight: a shape (`table`, `list`, …), `{ variant, rows?, columns?, fields? }`, or `none`.

selectedId.description: Currently selected node id (any level of the ID scheme above).

onReorder.description: Reorder a node within the tree. Threaded to FileTree's `onNodeReorder` seam — presence-gated there, so omitting it just means no dragging.

userType.description: Studio persona viewing the inspector. Controls tab visibility (Code is architect-only, Styles is universal) and section visibility (Entity, raw guard, raw effects are architect-only). Default `'builder'` matches pre-Phase-2 behavior except for the new Styles tab, which every persona gets.

themeManifest.description: Project theme tokens. The Styles tab reads them for Global edits (and, on the synthesized `__design_system__` schema, lists them all); those edits emit `UI:PROP_CHANGE` with `scope: 'global'` + `tokenGroup`/`tokenKey`.

defaultTab.description: Initial tab on mount. Local state still owns the active tab after that — this does not make the component controlled. Enables deep-linking into a specific tab (e.g. from a LayersPanel selection).

onTabChange.description: Fires whenever the tab-bar selection changes.

selectedPattern.description: In-node pattern selection, when this inspector is rendered OUTSIDE `FlowCanvas` (see `FlowCanvas`'s `externalInspector` + `onSelectedPatternChange`). `PatternSelectionContext` only reaches descendants of `FlowCanvas`'s own render tree, so a standalone consumer has no other way to feed pattern-level selection in — pass `FlowCanvas`'s `onSelectedPatternChange` payload straight through here. When omitted (the inline, built-in-inspector usage), falls back to `PatternSelectionContext`, unchanged.

elementAccess.description: What the selected element lets the user change; `ElementEditAccessContext` (inside a canvas) when omitted.

schema.description: The program the transition belongs to (object or JSON text), when it is given by position instead of `transition`.

transitionIndex.description: The transition's position among the trait's transitions, read from `schema`.

scene.description: Played steps; the one at `cursor` that ran this transition lights the boards (with `schema`).

cursor.description: The scene step shown. Default: the last.

annotations.description: Author explanations shown in a popover on hover: the transition's event note and per-effect-type notes.

src.description: URL of any other embeddable player page; used when no `videoId` is set
